title: Code and grouped split for: Near-Duplicate Data Leakage Inflates Deep Learning Performance in Multiclass Kidney Disease Classification from CT
description: Code, grouped (duplicate-aware) split file, result tables and the deployed INT8 research-prototype model for a study of near-duplicate leakage on the CT-KIDNEY dataset. The split file lists all 12,446 images with MD5, dHash and pHash codes, group id and split; the images themselves are not redistributed and are available from figshare (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.30342133.v1). The application is a research prototype and is not a medical device.
